The $150 IG floor was breached INTRADAY for the second time in the distribution window (first breach: June 23, $147.11 all-time low): today's $148.51 low is $1.49 below $150. However, SPCX closed at $152.15 — above $150 — for the FOURTH consecutive session. The IG floor has held on a CLOSING basis through all four intraday tests. Russell 1000 addition was formally executed at 4 PM ET (SpaceX added to the Russell 1000 Index). Bond distribution clearance est. ~8–10 business days from today's formal settlement (July 7–10); volume normalization below 5M shares/day is the clearance signal. The $185 two-consecutive-close re-entry gate requires distribution clearance as prerequisite — the reconstitution addition does NOT unlock re-entry.

decision.horizon: STEP ASIDE at HIGH conviction — UNCHANGED AND FURTHER CONFIRMED. decision.rationale: STEP ASIDE at HIGH conviction — REINFORCED. The June 26 session was the definitive confirmation of the distribution mechanic: SpaceX's Russell 1000 addition created systematic passive buying at 4 PM ET (the same one-time structural positive that was identified in the morning brief as 'insufficient to change the step-aside posture') and still could not sustain SPCX above the prior session's $152.91 close — final close was $152.15 (−$0.76). The $148.51 intraday low — a $1.49 breach of the $150 IG floor — is the second intraday break below the floor in the distribution window (after June 23's $147.11 all-time low), confirming the $150 level is NOT a hard structural floor but a closing support that continues to erode. Bond distribution clearance is the prerequisite for any change in posture. Re-entry gate: two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume AFTER confirmed volume normalization below 5M shares.

analysis:
## Technical analysis (post-close, June 26)

**Session recap:** Opened near prior close, spiked to $158.40 (Russell 1000 reconstitution intraday high), then reversed to test $148.51 (second intraday breach of $150 IG floor), then recovered to close at $152.15. Classic reconstitution 'buy the rumor, sell the news' pattern: the forced passive buying created the intraday high; bond distribution supply absorbed the entire bid and pushed to new session lows before the close recovered.

**IG floor status:** Held on closing basis for fourth consecutive session ($152.15 > $150). However, the intraday low ($148.51) represents the second closing-support breach this distribution window. The floor is stressed but intact.

**Distribution staircase:** Closing prices forming a compressed staircase: $154.54 → $152.91 → $152.15. Rate of decline is slowing (−$1.63 → −$0.76/session), consistent with the expected distribution pace tapering before clearance.

**Volume signal:** 126.91M shares (below the ~200M+ average daily volume) — Day 4 volume is lower than Days 1–3, consistent with the expected gradual volume normalization toward the 5M shares clearance signal.

**Re-entry gate:** $185 on two consecutive closes + above-average volume + confirmed distribution clearance. September 2 first earnings is the structural catalyst.
